project_context: The Isle Evrima (La Isla Nublar LATAM) - Community Dashboard Skins Shop
vibe: Fortnite Item Shop meets Prehistoric/Sci-Fi Survival. Immersive, high-contrast, tempting, and urgent (FOMO).

typography.guidelines: Use JetBrains Mono strictly for countdown timers and technical data. Use Cabinet Grotesk (uppercase, tracking-tight) for Shop Section Titles (Destacados, Diario, Temporada) and Skin Names.

colors.guidelines: Do not overuse the primary gold/green; reserve it for Call-to-Actions (Buy/Equip). Use the Rarity colors to create radial gradients behind the skin images inside the cards (e.g., radial-gradient from rarity color at 20% opacity to transparent at edges).

layouts_and_grids.shop_layout: Bento-style Grid Protocol. Avoid uniform squares.

sections.Destacados: Grid items span 2 columns and 2 rows (large impact, Hero-style cards).
sections.Temporada: Wide banners spanning full width or 3 columns.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing between sections (gap-12 or py-16). Tight spacing within the grids (gap-4).
layouts_and_grids.mobile: Stack vertically but maintain hierarchy (Featured items are taller, Daily items are a 2-column grid).

SkinCard.instructions: Fortnite-style layout. Container is relative, overflow-hidden, rounded-lg, border border-white/5. Background uses a subtle tint of the rarity color. Image is centered and absolute, bursting out of its inner bounds. Add a bottom panel with heavy backdrop-blur (glass) that houses the Skin Name (Cabinet Grotesk) and Price (Stripe icon/badge). Hover: framer-motion scale 1.03, elevate shadow, brightness up. Owned state: grayscale filter on the image, 'Adquirido' badge.

ShopSection.instructions: Section wrapper. Header contains the Section Title (left) and a live countdown timer (right) with JetBrains Mono. Pass items array to map into SkinCards.

SkinDetailModal.instructions: Use shadcn Dialog. Content must use the existing `.glass-strong` CSS class for the background. Layout: 2 columns. Left column: Massive skin render with floating animation (`animate-float`). Right column: Name, Rarity badge, description, countdown remaining, big primary 'Buy via Stripe' button or 'Equip to Dino' button if owned. If buying, overlay a loading spinner.

AdminSkinForm.instructions: Dashboard view for Admins. Dense, functional UI. Form fields: Name, Image URL, Rarity (Select), Section (Select: Destacados/Diario/Temporada), Price, Currency (USD), Start Date, End Date (DatePickers). Use shadcn Form, Input, Select, Popover+Calendar.

motion_and_audio.hover: Card scale-up (spring physics, stiffness 300, damping 20). Audio: subtle 'tick' or 'whoosh' using useSound.
motion_and_audio.purchase_success: Trigger golden flash on the screen, transition Buy button to 'Owned'. Audio: rewarding 'cha-ching' or 'level-up' style SFX.
motion_and_audio.equip: Button click snaps the state instantly with a satisfying 'click/clack' SFX.
motion_and_audio.timers: Timers must tick every second smoothly without re-rendering the whole page (use local component state or refs for the timer).

websockets.instructions: Establish a WebSocket connection (or use existing context) on mount. Listen for 'shop_update'. When a new item drops, animate it into the grid. When an item expires/sells out, instantly overlay the 'Agotado/Sold Out' state on its SkinCard. Listen for 'purchase_success' to auto-update the user's inventory.

accessibility.contrast: Cards with glowing backgrounds must have high-contrast text. Use drop-shadows on white text overlaying images.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements must have data-testid: 'skin-card-[id]', 'buy-btn-[id]', 'equip-btn-[id]', 'admin-submit-skin'.

dinosaur_skeleton_skin.description: Use this as the image URL for the 'Bones' or 'Skeleton' Legendary skin.

jungle_atmosphere.description: Use as a very low-opacity fixed background or header banner for the Shop page to give an immersive jungle feel.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: No generic centered layouts. Use grid-based asymmetrical storytelling (Bento style).
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. You must use shadcn dropdown-menu, select, and calendar components for the Admin Panel.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds on overlay components. Always use `.glass-strong` or `.glass`.
Implement the UI exclusively with plain React (.js) + Tailwind and shadcn/ui. No TypeScript (.tsx).
Integrate the Stripe buy flow as a mock or standard button payload to a backend endpoint.
Every component should handle loading, empty, and error states elegantly (e.g., Skeleton loaders for the shop grid before WebSocket sync).
Rarity is crucial for a Fortnite-style shop. Emphasize the rarity colors in glows (`box-shadow`), borders, and text gradients.
